'''Veknoids''', also known as '''Velkoids''', were a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moonus Mandel/Legends|Moonus Mandel]].

Veknoids were characterized by large eyes, floppy ears, and short fur. They were extremely moralistic and engaged in arranged marriages.<ref name="TCSWE" />

The Veknoids had pointed teeth, prominent stubby horns, and sported long tails.

The famous [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilot [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] was a Veknoid. Some Veknoids joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], such as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zao]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
